    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">重构《手搓》TaskFactory带你更安全的起飞</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        话说上次《手搓》TaskFactory就原地起飞了
网友@舟翅桐和@0611163说飞得还不错,但你能不能拽着点,我恐高
于是有了这次的重构和优化
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一彻底的重构和优化">一、彻底的重构和优化</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>本次《手搓》TaskFactory的重构是直接把依赖的《手搓》线程池一起重构了</li>
<li>可以参看上一篇<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19168188" target="_blank">异步"伪线程"重构《手搓》线程池,支持任务清退</a></li>
<li>也就是说安全系数非常高,直接在线程里面处理</li>
<li>大家可以更安全更放心的起飞</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二先看一下同步任务取消的case">二、先看一下同步任务取消的Case</h2>
<h3 id="1-手搓taskfactory手动取消同步任务">1. 《手搓》TaskFactory手动取消同步任务</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>执行同步方法Hello</li>
<li>等待100毫秒后调用Cancel</li>
<li>等待117毫秒,触发异常</li>
<li>之后在另一个线程Hello还是执行了</li>
<li>如果方法已经执行很可能无法真实的取消(除非增加token参数来控制)</li>
<li>但Task已经反馈给调用方本次取消,不会继续等待</li>
<li>当前“线程”也回收了,避免由此可能导致的线程池堵塞</li>
<li>有人可能说,这有什么稀奇的,系统API就支持</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 1000), tokenSource.Token);
Assert.NotNull(task);
await Task.Delay(100);
tokenSource.Cancel();
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
await Task.Delay(1000);

void Hello(string name, int time = 10)
{
    Thread.Sleep(time);
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Hello {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
}

// Thread19 System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Tasks.ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.ActionCancel() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Tasks\ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.cs:line 90
// Thread19 Total Span :121.4448
// Thread11 Hello 张三,11:41:00.641
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-系统taskfactory手动取消任务">2. 系统TaskFactory手动取消任务</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>系统TaskFactory的流程和前面一样</li>
<li>也是执行同步方法Hello</li>
<li>等待100毫秒后调用Cancel</li>
<li>执行成功,共耗时1秒</li>
<li>是不是很魔幻,居然没取消</li>
<li>系统TaskFactory有Bug?</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var factory = Task.Factory;
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 1000), tokenSource.Token);
Assert.NotNull(task);
await Task.Delay(100);
tokenSource.Cancel();
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

// Thread10 Hello 张三,11:43:06.118
// Thread19 Total Span :1006.9077
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-手搓taskfactory设置超时case">3. 《手搓》TaskFactory设置超时Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>还是同步方法Hello</li>
<li>这次通过CancelAfter设置1秒超时</li>
<li>等待1秒触发异常</li>
<li>也就是说《手搓》TaskFactory超时清退成功</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
tokenSource.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 2000), tokenSource.Token);
Assert.NotNull(task);
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
await Task.Delay(1000);

// Thread16 System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Tasks.ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.ActionTimeout() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Tasks\ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.cs:line 114
// Thread16 Total Span :1075.7213
// Thread11 Hello 张三,15:57:04.440
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-系统taskfactory设置超时case">4. 系统TaskFactory设置超时Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>执行同步方法Hello</li>
<li>通过CancelAfter设置1秒超时</li>
<li>任务执行成功,耗时2秒</li>
<li>再次魔幻的结果,居然又没取消</li>
<li>系统TaskFactory有Bug?</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var factory = Task.Factory;
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
tokenSource.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 2000), tokenSource.Token);
Assert.NotNull(task);
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

// Thread10 Hello 张三,10:39:45.556
// Total Span :2017.2007
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-系统taskfactory修改再测">5. 系统TaskFactory修改再测</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>把Cancel提前到StartNew之前</li>
<li>这次耗时106毫秒,任务取消</li>
<li>原来系统TaskFactory是要添加任务的时候判断是否取消,而不是执行的时候</li>
<li>意外不意外,惊喜不惊喜</li>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory是执行时判断是否取消</li>
<li>你满意系统TaskFactory的Cancel逻辑还是《手搓》TaskFactory</li>
<li>很长一段时间笔者都以为系统TaskFactory有Bug</li>
<li>原来是设计如此,终于破案了</li>
<li>如果说《手搓》TaskFactory是系统TaskFactory增强版不为过吧</li>
<li>作为系统TaskFactory的平替也是个不错的选择吧</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var factory = Task.Factory;
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
tokenSource.Cancel();
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 1000), tokenSource.Token);
Assert.NotNull(task);
await Task.Delay(100);
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
// System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Tasks.TaskFactoryTests.ActionCancel2() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Tasks\TaskFactoryTests.cs:line 69
// Total Span :106.1664
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三异步任务的case">三、异步任务的Case</h2>
<h3 id="1-手搓taskfactory并发控制并清退超时任务的case">1. 《手搓》TaskFactory并发控制并清退超时任务的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为1,设置1秒超时</li>
<li>这个CancellationToken参数传给实际执行的异步方法同时也传给线程池</li>
<li>以便线程池及时处理并及时清理已经取消的任务</li>
<li>还起到双保险的作用</li>
<li>如果HelloAsync没有对CancellationToken做出正确的处理</li>
<li>调用者也会及时触发取消的异常</li>
<li>本次执行3个异步任务,每个500毫秒</li>
<li>耗时1秒,两个任务执行成功,并触发取消异常</li>
<li>第3个并未实际执行,这里要归功于token参数起到了拦截的作用</li>
<li>系统TaskFactory没有控制异步和并发的逻辑就不对比</li>
<li>另外需要特别强调《手搓》TaskFactory支持调用异步,但必须是使用StartTask方法</li>
<li>如果使用StartNew方法意味着把异步方法当同步执行</li>
<li>就不能控制并发了,只是简单触发之后在系统线程池里执行而已</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
tokenSource.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
var token = tokenSource.Token;
var task = factory.StartTask((t) =&gt; HelloAsync("张三", 500, t), token);
var task2 = factory.StartTask((t) =&gt; HelloAsync("李四", 500, t), token);
var task3 = factory.StartTask((t) =&gt; HelloAsync("王二", 500, t), token);
try
{
    await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
await Task.Delay(2000);

async Task HelloAsync(string name, int time = 10, CancellationToken token = default)
{
    await Task.Delay(time, token);
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} HelloAsync {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
}

// Thread31 HelloAsync 张三,10:30:54.720
// Thread11 HelloAsync 李四,10:30:55.231
// System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Tasks.ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.TaskCancel0() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Tasks\ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.cs:line 126
// Total Span :1013.774
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-单并发控制异步任务的case">2. 单并发控制异步任务的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为1</li>
<li>手搓线程池就可以让它摆出一字长蛇阵</li>
<li>虽然线程Id不只1个,但都是间隔相同时间(误差不超过1毫秒)</li>
<li>并发控制那是相当的稳</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
StartTask(factory);
await Task.Delay(10000);

private void StartTask(ConcurrentTaskFactory factory)
{
    for (int i = 1; i &lt; 100; i++)
    {
        var user = "User" + i;
        factory.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync(user));
    }
}
async Task HelloAsync(string name, int time = 10, CancellationToken token = default)
{
    await Task.Delay(time, token);
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} HelloAsync {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
}

<h3 id="3-多并发控制异步任务的case">3. 多并发控制异步任务的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为10</li>
<li>清晰可见的10个并发</li>
<li>虽然线程数量是在线程池里是从0开始按指数关系(0,1,2,4,8)递增到ConcurrencyLevel配置</li>
<li>但误差不超过1毫秒</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 10 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
StartTask(factory);
await Task.Delay(10000);

// Thread38 HelloAsync User98,09:45:23.992
// Thread33 HelloAsync User96,09:45:23.992
// Thread35 HelloAsync User97,09:45:23.992
// Thread34 HelloAsync User94,09:45:23.992
// Thread33 HelloAsync User91,09:45:23.992
// Thread36 HelloAsync User92,09:45:23.992
// Thread31 HelloAsync User93,09:45:23.992
// Thread32 HelloAsync User95,09:45:23.992
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-网友舟翅桐的case也再跑一次">4. 网友@舟翅桐的Case也再跑一次</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这个Case是他在<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19168188" target="_blank">上一篇博文</a>的评论里提出的</li>
<li>是个非常有意思的Case</li>
<li>同时这里特别感谢@舟翅桐提出任务清退的概念</li>
<li>3个并发分别执行3个不同异步任务</li>
<li>每个方法有开始和结束日志</li>
<li>可以清晰的看到每3个开始再3个结束</li>
<li>每个任务0.1秒,执行30个任务,3个并发</li>
<li>总耗时1秒,Nice!!!</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 3 });
List&lt;Task&lt;int&gt;&gt; tasks = new(30);
for (int i = 0; i &lt; 10; i++)
{
    var index = i;
    var t1 = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; One(index));
    var t2 = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; Two(index));
    var t3 = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; Three(index));

    tasks.Add(t1);
    tasks.Add(t2);
    tasks.Add(t3);
}

await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine("Total Span :" + sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds);

public async Task&lt;int&gt; One(int i, CancellationToken token = default)
{
    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} One Start {i}:{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    await Task.Delay(100, token);
    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} One End {i}:{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    return 1;
}
public async Task&lt;int&gt; Two(int i, CancellationToken token = default)
{
    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Two Start {i}:{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    await Task.Delay(100, token);
    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Two End {i}:{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    return 2;
}
public async Task&lt;int&gt; Three(int i, CancellationToken token = default)
{
    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Three Start {i}:{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    await Task.Delay(100, token);
    token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Three End {i}:{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    return 3;
}

// Thread31 Three Start 0:09:50:48.945
// Thread11 One Start 0:09:50:48.945
// Thread8 Two Start 0:09:50:48.945
// Thread31 Two End 0:09:50:49.050
// Thread8 Three End 0:09:50:49.050

// Thread31 One End 2:09:50:49.273
// Thread8 Three End 2:09:50:49.273

// Thread31 Two Start 3:09:50:49.273

// Thread8 Three End 3:09:50:49.385
// Thread8 One Start 4:09:50:49.385
// Thread11 Two Start 4:09:50:49.385
// Thread32 One End 3:09:50:49.385
// Thread32 Three Start 4:09:50:49.385

// Thread11 Two End 4:09:50:49.497

// Thread32 One Start 5:09:50:49.497

// Thread32 Two End 5:09:50:49.609

// Thread34 One End 9:09:50:50.057
// Thread32 Two End 9:09:50:50.057

</code></pre>
<h2 id="四全局设置超时的case">四、全局设置超时的Case</h2>
<h3 id="1-同步任务无cancellationtoken的case">1. 同步任务无CancellationToken的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ItemLife配置为1秒</li>
<li>Hello实际需要2秒</li>
<li>调用等待1秒后触发取消异常,与ItemLife配置一致</li>
<li>同步任务清退成功</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1, ItemLife = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 2000));
Assert.NotNull(task);
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
await Task.Delay(1000);

// Thread16 System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Tasks.ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.ActionItemLife() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Tasks\ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.cs:line 35
// Thread16 Total Span :1016.3529
// Thread11 Hello 张三,16:09:49.847
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-异步任务无cancellationtoken的case">2. 异步任务无CancellationToken的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ItemLife配置为1秒</li>
<li>HelloAsync实际需要2秒</li>
<li>调用等待1秒后触发取消异常,与ItemLife配置一致</li>
<li>异步任务也清退成功</li>
<li>由于本次没有给HelloAsync传token,虽然清退了,HelloAsync还是稍后在其他线程执行了</li>
<li>这个Case再次证明token参数的重要性,可以避免不必要的操作</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new TaskFactoryOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1, ItemLife = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("张三", 2000));
Assert.NotNull(task);
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
await Task.Delay(2000);

// Thread17 System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Tasks.ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.TaskItemLife() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Tasks\ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.cs:line 65
// Thread17 Total Span :1020.1329
// Thread8 HelloAsync 张三,16:14:04.831
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五揭秘重构手搓taskfactory">五、揭秘重构《手搓》TaskFactory</h2>
<h3 id="1-前1版本手搓taskfactory是基于并发配额控制">1. 前1版本《手搓》TaskFactory是基于并发配额控制</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>启动异步扣除并发配额</li>
<li>注册ContinueWith返还并发配额</li>
<li>参考以前的博文<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19168188" target="_blank">《手搓》TaskFactory带你安全的起飞</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-重构手搓taskfactory去掉了并发配额控制">2. 重构《手搓》TaskFactory去掉了并发配额控制</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>去掉并发配额控制</li>
<li>异步线程直接在线程池里面await</li>
<li>线程池原生支持性能更好</li>
<li>线程池大小就是最好的并发控制,原生支持后并发配额完全不需要</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="六总结">六、总结</h2>
<h3 id="1-手搓taskfactory的作用">1. 《手搓》TaskFactory的作用</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory的主要作用是并发控制</li>
<li>.net实现异步多并发很容易,但是并发太大很容易失控</li>
<li>比如数据库连接过高、上游服务被打挂</li>
<li>为此很多人都把.net程序写成“单线程”模式</li>
<li>即使写成“单线程”模式依然避免不了上游资源被打挂的事故</li>
<li>通过《手搓》TaskFactory可以设置为全局模式,来管控某些某些资源的并发控制</li>
<li>同时程序改动极小</li>
<li>无论是同步操作还是异步都可以托管给《手搓》TaskFactory</li>
<li>也就是实现程序的异步多并发的起飞</li>
<li>加上CancellationToken和ItemLife可以保证线程池的不会被堵塞</li>
<li>安全高效的线程池助力.net程序安全的起飞</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-手搓线程池的作用">2. 《手搓》线程池的作用</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>其一支持《手搓》TaskFactory的执行处理</li>
<li>其二支持事件总线的事件派发</li>
<li>拿来做一个毫秒级的任务调度系统应该也没什么问题</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-cancellationtoken">3. CancellationToken</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>及时清退任务的关键之一是CancellationToken</li>
<li><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19192440" target="_blank">前文</a>已经说明,CancellationToken是放飞异步的风筝线</li>
<li>用好CancellationToken,是安全使用异步的关键之一</li>
<li>特别是含await的异步方法</li>
<li>当await成功后很可能已经发生了线程切换,耗时更是不确定的因素</li>
<li>这时很可能要校验CancellationToken判断是否还有必要继续执行</li>
<li>多步骤逻辑耗时,每一步骤前也很可能需要判断是否还有必要继续执行后面的步骤</li>
<li>耗时循环,每次循环也很可能需要判断是否还有必要继续执行</li>
<li>在某些特殊情况,同步方法也可能有必要增加CancellationToken</li>
<li>给实际执行的方法传CancellationToken的同时传给《手搓》TaskFactory或者《手搓》线程池,可以实现双保险</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="4-itemlife">4. ItemLife</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ItemLife是线程池兜底的安全机制</li>
<li>可以有效避免线程池被堵塞</li>
<li>特别是那些还没来得及加CancellationToken的祖传代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>好了,就介绍到这里,更多信息请查看源码库<br>
